params.body:
The README was eleven bytes, the title alone. This one says what the repo itself says: what Naviskore is (from CLAUDE.md), the stack (composer.json, package.json, phpstan.neon), the environments (elixir.json), how to run and test it (env.example, phpunit.xml, the Mix scripts), the artisan commands by their real signatures, and what Forge and Elixir read from it (`/up`, `/.well-known/build.json`, `/api/elixir`, the two workflows).

First pull request through the control gateway from the workbench: proposed by a session on the Mac, judged and pushed by the gateway under the grant of `#agent-workbench`, with a capability Portal signed on the owner token.
params.title: README: what the repo says about itself
